# DigitalWorkshop — Web Development & Interactive Digital Studio

> Digital workshop and catalog of interactive web applications, games, and developer utilities built with SvelteKit, TypeScript, and modern web standards.

## Main Pages

- [Digital Workshop (Головна)](https://alik532ua.github.io/DigitalWorkshop/): Showcase of interactive web applications, tools, and digital solutions.
- [English Version](https://alik532ua.github.io/DigitalWorkshop/en/): Portfolio and app catalog in English.

## Featured Applications & Projects

- [MindStep](https://alik532ua.github.io/MindStep/): Step-by-step cognitive training game and educational tool.
- [Slovko](https://alik532ua.github.io/Slovko/): Daily Ukrainian linguistic word-guessing puzzle.
- [Adopt an Animal](https://adoptananimal.github.io/adoptananimal/): Charity animal adoption platform.
- [Developer Resume](https://alik532ua.github.io/CV/): Professional background and engineering credentials.

## Key Capabilities

- Web application architecture with SvelteKit 2 and Svelte 5 runes.
- Offline-first Progressive Web Apps (PWA) with fast prerendered delivery.
- Comprehensive accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA) and fluid design systems.
- Generative Engine Optimization (GEO/LLMO) and Schema.org structured data.
